transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm explaining this right. I guess I'm just here because I've been having a little bit of trouble staying on track with things? 

It's probably not a huge deal, honestly, but... well, for example, if I'm trying to work on a job application, I just get sort of pulled away by every little sound or thought. Like a car driving by outside, or my phone, or even just some random idea popping into my head. It just sends me somewhere else before I even notice I stopped working. 

I know everyone gets a little distracted sometimes, so maybe I'm just overthinking it... does that make sense? Is that the kind of thing you usually help people with?
Do you often feel restless or find yourself needing to be constantly moving, even when you're trying to focus on something specific?

Um, yeah, I guess I do a little bit? I mean, I hope this doesn't sound too weird... but yeah. 

I used to play soccer a lot, and that kept me pretty active. But since I can't really play like before, sitting around the house just gets... well, it's probably just normal pent-up energy, honestly. But sometimes I feel almost like I'm crawling out of my skin if I try to just sit still. So I end up just kind of pacing from room to room a lot. 

I know that probably sounds a little strange, and I'm sure lots of guys my age do that when they're between jobs, right? I just need to stretch my legs, I guess. Is that... is that the kind of restlessness you mean?
When you're trying to work on tasks like a job application, do you find it hard to organize your thoughts or get started, or do you often forget steps or lose track of what you were doing?

Um, yeah, I guess organizing things can be a little... tricky for me sometimes? I mean, I'm sure everyone gets a little overwhelmed when they have a lot on their plate, right? 

But, um, like... if I have a bunch of things I know I need to get done in a day, like, say I need to call my counselor, and I should probably tidy up my room, and then work on that job application... I just sort of look at it all and I don't really know which one is the right one to do first. So I end up kind of... bouncing around? Like, I'll start cleaning, and then remember the application, so I go do a little of that, and then... well, I guess I end up with a lot of things that are only half-finished. 

I know I just need to try harder to stick to a schedule, I really do. But... does that sound like what you were asking about? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of examples.
Have you ever found yourself acting on impulse without really thinking about the consequences, like saying something you later regret or making sudden decisions that you didn't plan?

Um, maybe a little bit? I mean, I really try to be polite, I promise I do. But... well, sometimes I guess I can be a little quick to answer? 

Like, if I'm talking to my mom, or even my counselor, and they're asking me something... sometimes the answer just sort of jumps into my head, and I end up saying it out loud before they've even finished their sentence. I don't mean to cut them off or be rude, it's just like my brain gets too far ahead and my mouth just goes. 

I always feel really bad about it afterwards, and I know I need to work on being a better listener. I'm sure it's just a bad habit I need to break, right? I hope that doesn't make me sound like a jerk... is that the kind of impulsive thing you mean?

Outside of what you've already described, do you often find it hard to pay attention during conversations, tend to interrupt others frequently, or feel like you're always in motion even when you want to relax?

Um, well, regarding the moving around part... I guess even when I'm supposed to be relaxing, I'm still kind of on the go? Like, even on days when I don't have work or, you know, training or anything, I find myself just... moving from the kitchen, out to the garage, and then over to my game setup. 

It's almost like I feel like I'm supposed to be doing something all the time, even when I'm just trying to chill out. I try really hard to just sit and take it easy, I promise I do. But I guess my body just likes to stay busy. That's probably a pretty normal thing, right? Just wanting to stay active? I don't want you to think I'm completely out of control or anything... I just like to keep checking on things around the house. Did I... did I answer that okay for you?

Can you tell me if these issues with staying focused, feeling restless, and acting impulsively happen in different places or situations, like at home, in public, or when you're with friends, or do they mostly happen in just one place or situation?

Um, well... I guess they kind of happen everywhere? But not in a bad way, I promise! I mean, I'm sure it's mostly just me needing to pay better attention, you know? 

Like, at home, I definitely do the bouncing around thing I mentioned, just moving from room to room. And, um, when I'm out with friends, or even just running errands... I guess I still get a little restless, or maybe talk a bit too fast if I get excited about something. I really try to keep it under control when I'm around other people, though. I don't want to be annoying or anything. 

I'm sure it's pretty normal to be a little scattered sometimes, no matter where you are, right? I just... I hope I'm not making it sound worse than it is. Does that make sense?
